propositions: Auto-deploy drains in-flight reviews for only 45s while reviews timeout at 1200s, causing the drain to expire mid-review and cast a fail-closed -1 vote that blocks the backfill reconciler's recovery mechanism.
Transient GitHub git-fetch hangs exceed the 300s timeout, causing adapter.py to convert the error into a vote-bearing BLOCK that the reconciler treats as already-voted and skips forever.
Retryable conditions (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled) should post no vote and defer to the backfill reconciler rather than casting a fail-closed -1 that disables recovery.
Coverage-gap decisions must thread a machine-readable gap_reason to distinguish retryable errors from terminal verdicts (finding, indeterminate).

A new review_attempts ledger must track consecutive retryable failures per (change_id, revision) and escalate to a fail-closed -1 vote with retries-exhausted note after a configurable limit (default 3 attempts).
Container teardown mid-review must be detected via a shutdown cancel flag so CancelledError is treated as retryable no-vote rather than fail-closed -1.
